params.message:
Opening hours: one line under the hours, "Daarbuiten op afspraak"

Saturday 07:30 to 12:00 is a regular opening line; outside all the
hours a visit is by appointment. That is one line under the hours, not
a note on Saturday.

- Pages::hoursExtra(): Sanity's siteSettings.hoursNote (localeString)
  in the current language. Without Sanity settings the built-in line
  "Daarbuiten op afspraak"; with them, Sanity's value, so an editor can
  also leave it empty.
- Shown under the hours in the footer (max-w so a long text wraps
  instead of widening the column), on the contact page, on the seller
  card of a vehicle page, and at the end of the contact meta
  description.
- The built-in Saturday line drops its "op afspraak" note; the seed
  export carries hoursNote.
